_comment: How creators are ranked. Every component is 0..1 and the weights should add up to 1. Credibility carries more weight than a generic influencer search because ClarityTX sells to clinicians: a creator with ND/MD/RD/health-coach credentials talks to the people who buy it. Tune freely; run `npm run rescore` afterwards to re-rank everyone already in the pipeline.
_reach_comment: Followers are scored on a log scale between 10^log_min (~3k) and 10^log_max (~5M), so 40k engaged followers are not buried by 2M passive ones.
_engagement_comment: Engagement is (lifetime likes / videos) / followers, because per-video views need a logged-in session. Above distrust_above the number is usually an artifact of one old viral video, so it is scored as a middling 0.5 and flagged for a human look.
